children: MetLife reported preliminary variable investment income of at least $600 million (pre-tax) for Q3 2026.
Preliminary Q3 variable investment income estimated at least $600M pre-tax, based on results to date.
This compares with MetLife’s full-year 2026 guidance of approximately $1.6B pre-tax for variable investment income.
Variable investment income includes private equity, real estate and other funds and prepayment fees, affecting investment performance metrics.
Results are unaudited and preliminary; final figures could differ materially after quarter-close and GAAP reporting.
